raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Summary

FlashInferMxFp4LinearKernel hardcodes backend="cute-dsl" for the scaled FP4 GEMM. However, the CuTe DSL backend is only available on SM10x/11x GPUs. On SM12x GPUs, this causes the following failure:

```
flashinfer.utils.BackendSupportedError: mm_fp4 does not support backend
'cute-dsl' with capability 120
```

FlashInfer's mm_fp4 already supports backend="auto", which automatically dispatches to the best available backend for the current device (e.g., cute-dsl on SM10x, cudnn on SM12x, etc.). Since the library already knows which backend to select, there is no reason to hardcode a specific one.

This PR switches the GEMM backend from "cute-dsl" to "auto" and removes the manual backend selection logic.

## What changed

- `flashinfer_scaled_fp4_mm(backend="cute-dsl")` → `backend="auto"`

---

## Test Plan

## Test Result

---
<details>
<summary> Essential Elements of an Effective PR Description Checklist </summary>

- [ ] The purpose of the PR, such as "Fix some issue (link existing issues this PR will resolve)".
- [ ] The test plan, such as providing test command.
- [ ] The test results, such as pasting the results comparison before and after, or e2e results
- [ ] (Optional) The necessary documentation update, such as updating `supported_models.md` and `examples` for a new model.
</details>

nodes.body:
Tested end to end on an RTX PRO 4000 Blackwell (sm_120, driver 610.57) with nightly `0.30.1rc1.dev740`, flashinfer-python / flashinfer-cubin / flashinfer-jit-cache 0.7.0.post1 (`has_flashinfer()` and `has_flashinfer_cutedsl()` both True). Model: `nm-testing/TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat-v1.0-MXFP4`, greedy, two runs each, with the compile cache cleared between configurations.

- **main:** both runs fail during compile/warmup with `flashinfer.utils.BackendSupportedError: mm_fp4 does not support backend 'cute-dsl' with capability 120`.
- **with this PR's one-line change** (`backend="cute-dsl"` → `backend="auto"` in the `flashinfer_scaled_fp4_mm` call): `Using FlashInferMxFp4LinearKernel for MXFP4 GEMM`, both runs load and generate coherent text (" Paris. The capital of France is Paris. ...").

The activation quantize (`flashinfer_mxfp4_quantize(..., backend="cute-dsl")`) is left as is in this PR and works on sm_120. Only the GEMM rejects the backend.

Still needed on main: `--quantization mxfp4` on Qwen3-4B fails at boot on SM120, and with this PR it serves through `FlashInferMxFp4LinearKernel`.
Setup: RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q, main `153a17166e` with and without this PR's change, FlashInfer 0.7.2.

**Boot on main.** Main's engine core fails at startup:

```
ValueError: SM12x cute-dsl requires NVFP4 with 128x4 scales
```

**Accuracy.** Full GSM8K (1319 questions, 5-shot, flexible extract):

| Arm | MXFP4 linear kernel | GSM8K |
| --- | --- | --- |
| BF16 | none | 0.861 |
| main | boot fails | n/a (boot fails) |
| this PR | `FlashInferMxFp4LinearKernel` (W4A4) | **0.708** |
| Humming | `HummingMxFp4LinearKernel` (W4A4) | 0.685 |
| Marlin | `MarlinMxFp4LinearKernel` (weight-only) | 0.779 |

The PR is close to the other W4A4 path and below weight-only Marlin.

**That gap is the format.** A GEMM check at Qwen3-4B's dense shapes with real weights:

| Comparison | Relative L2, q/o/gate/down projections, M in {1, 16, 128, 1024} |
| --- | --- |
| Auto-selected GEMM against the exact FP32 product of its quantized operands (kernel error) | 1.66e-3 to 1.69e-3 |
| MXFP4 activations and weights against the unquantized product (format cost) | **0.159 to 0.168** |

The kernel adds almost nothing on top of what the MXFP4 format itself costs.

<details><summary>Commands</summary>

```
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-4B --revision 1cfa9a7208912126459214e8b04321603b3df60c --max-model-len 4096 --seed 0 \
  --quantization mxfp4      # BF16 arm: no --quantization
# Humming arm: VLLM_DISABLED_KERNELS=FlashInferMxFp4LinearKernel,MarlinMxFp4LinearKernel
# Marlin arm:  VLLM_DISABLED_KERNELS=FlashInferMxFp4LinearKernel
lm_eval --model local-completions \
  --model_args model=Qwen/Qwen3-4B,base_url=http://127.0.0.1:8204/v1/completions,num_concurrent=64,max_retries=3,tokenized_requests=False,tokenizer_backend=None \
  --tasks gsm8k --num_fewshot 5 --batch_size 1 --gen_kwargs temperature=0,max_gen_toks=512

# GEMM check: vLLM's online MXFP4 quantization, flashinfer_scaled_fp4_mm per backend, FP32 product of the decoded operands
python mxfp4_gemm_check.py <Qwen3-4B snapshot>
```

</details>

The scripts, the GEMM check output and the raw GSM8K and server logs are in https://gist.github.com/waynehacking8/bd5b1e80ef4b87dc7b88a390e01ab412.

Same failure on a GB10 (sm_121, DGX Spark), nightly 0.32.1rc1.dev485+gceb01b6dd, flashinfer 0.7.2.post1, cuDNN 9.24. On main both `nm-testing/TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat-v1.0-MXFP4` and `INCModel/Qwen3-1.7B-AutoRound-MXFP4-W4A4` die on the first forward with `SM12x cute-dsl requires NVFP4 with 128x4 scales`.

With the one-liner they load (37 s / 34 s) and generate normal text. Profiler says auto lands on cuDNN on 12.1 too: 264 `cudnn_generated_fort_native_sm120_blockScaleMatMul_*` calls plus 88 of the `sm80` variant in one short generate.

TinyLlama vs bf16, teacher-forced on a fixed 440-token text: this PR mean |dlogprob| 0.39 (max 3.07); with FlashInfer disabled the selector falls to `MarlinMxFp4LinearKernel` here, 0.16 (max 2.20). Same W4A4 vs weight-only gap as the GSM8K numbers above.

## Claude Code Review

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.

detail.title: [Bugfix] Use FlashInfer auto backend for MXFP4 Linear GEMM instead of hardcoded cute-dsl

files.patch:
@@ -71,7 +71,7 @@ def apply_weights(
             layer.weight_scale,
             alpha=None,
             out_dtype=x.dtype,
-            backend="cute-dsl",
+            backend="auto",
             block_size=_MXFP4_GROUP_SIZE,
             use_nvfp4=False,
         )
